citations.M1: This cannot ship Thursday as planned. Thursday can safely take 0142 plus the fixed backfill plus a dual-write app release; the read switch goes in the following release, and 0143 only after that has run clean.
citations.M2: During the 6-minute rolling deploy, old pods insert `status` only and new pods insert `state` only, so each side's `mark_paid` silently misses the other's pending orders; ship a transitional release that dual-writes both columns and reads either.
citations.M3: `Order.from_row` calls `OrderState(None)` on every unbackfilled order and every `get_order` raises ... `mark_paid` matches on `state = 0`, which is NULL for unbackfilled pending orders, so the UPDATE silently affects 0 rows, returns 2xx, and paid orders are never marked paid
citations.M4: Backfill CASE has no ELSE, so `PAID`, `canceled`, `complete` and NULL rows (7,764 in prod) get `state = NULL` and stay NULL forever; map `lower(status)`, add `canceled`, decide `complete` and NULL with product, and raise on anything unmapped.
citations.M5: Paging with OFFSET over `WHERE state IS NULL` skips half the rows because the result set shrinks as you update it ... use keyset paging (`WHERE id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT n`).
citations.M6: The whole backfill runs in one transaction, holding row locks on every updated order until the end ... commit per batch
citations.M7: `jobs/nightly_finance_export.py` was missed because the grep stopped at `app/`; from Thursday night it silently excludes every new order (status NULL), and after 0143 it crashes
citations.M8: Required step between 3 and 4: verify `count(*) WHERE state IS NULL = 0` on the primary and confirm replica lag is back to zero.
citations.M9: which is why staging reported 1,055,000 of 2,104,377
citations.M10: Dropping `status` in 0143 is irreversible; its downgrade recreates an empty column, so no app rollback exists after step 4; defer the drop to a later release after a full cycle on `state`.
citations.M11: on 61M rows that is many hours, not the 11 minutes staging showed, and does not fit a Thursday window
citations.M12: `SET NOT NULL` on 61M rows takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock for a full table scan; add `CHECK (state IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID`, `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`, then `SET NOT NULL`
